parsed.post: Discarding WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 (1.0776) as it performed worse than my current best 5035a3d (1.0712). It seems the larger warmup is too long for this configuration. Reverting to 5035a3d and testing WARMUP_RATIO=0.02 to see if a tighter warmup allows for faster convergence at LR 0.08.
parsed.description: Testing a smaller WARMUP_RATIO=0.02 on the current best configuration (MATRIX_LR=0.08, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=524288) to see if a shorter warmup period helps reach lower loss faster.
